findings.title: active external aid toward him

findings.title: deity and sovereignty pressure
findings.claim: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is the definite endpoint of the exclusion phrase. Because it is the proper divine name in genitive after {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}), the first clause denies any helping faction from besides Allah. The formula belongs to a Surah 18 pattern that rejects supports besides Allah in 18:14, 18:15, and 18:26, then this closure prepares the next ayah's answer that true walāya belongs to Allah (18:44) and stands before the same-surah affirmation of Allah's power in 18:45.
